lines.zh: 牛蹄踩过平原的草，一步一步很稳。
lines.en: My hooves press the plains grass flat, one slow step at a time.

lines.zh: 花纹在阳光下像泼开的墨。
lines.en: These patches on my hide look like spilled ink in the sun.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸慢慢走，找嫩草。
lines.en: I follow the riverbank slowly, hunting for tender grass.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩着，赶走落在背上的蝇。
lines.en: My tail swings to chase flies off my back.

lines.zh: 平原的草太短，我走远一点。
lines.en: The plains grass is too short, so I walk farther.

lines.zh: 我低头啃草，边走边嚼。
lines.en: I chew as I walk, head low against the turf.

lines.zh: 同伴在前头，我跟着它的铃声。
lines.en: My herd mate is ahead, so I follow its bell.

lines.zh: 黑白花纹在草里格外显眼。
lines.en: Black and white patches stand out sharply against the green.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩进泥里，我拔出又落。
lines.en: One hoof sinks in mud, pulls free, then falls again.

lines.zh: 我认得回牛棚的每一条土路。
lines.en: I know every dirt track leading back to the barn.

lines.zh: 风从麦田吹来，我换了方向。
lines.en: Wind carries from the wheat field, so I change course.

lines.zh: 走累了，我停在树荫下喘气。
lines.en: Tired of walking, I stop and breathe under the shade.

lines.zh: 我反刍着，嘴边全是草沫。
lines.en: I chew my cud, grass foam at the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 十点生命，够我慢慢站一天。
lines.en: Ten points of life is enough to stand here slowly.

lines.zh: 我甩耳朵，赶那只不肯走的蝇。
lines.en: I flick my ear at a fly that refuses to leave.

lines.zh: 花纹晒热了，我挪到阴影里。
lines.en: My patches grow hot, so I shift into the shade.

lines.zh: 远处有牛叫，我抬了抬头。
lines.en: A cow calls far off and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 鼻子里是湿土和青草味。
lines.en: My nose holds wet soil and green grass.

lines.zh: 我站着打盹，腿还撑着身子。
lines.en: I doze standing up, legs still holding my weight.

lines.zh: 肚子咕噜一声，我看看草。
lines.en: My stomach grumbles once and I glance at the grass.

lines.zh: 尾巴自己摇，不用我管。
lines.en: My tail swings on its own, without my asking.

lines.zh: 这块平原安静得只剩咀嚼声。
lines.en: This plain is so quiet only chewing remains.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔鼻子，又低下头。
lines.en: I lick my nose, then lower my head again.

lines.zh: 皮下的花纹一抖一抖地动。
lines.en: The patches on my hide twitch as I breathe.

lines.zh: 有人挤过我的奶，桶还在栏边。
lines.en: Someone milked me; the bucket still sits by the fence.

lines.zh: 我把重量慢慢挪到另一条腿。
lines.en: I shift my weight slowly onto another leg.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼，嚼到没味道。
lines.en: I chew slowly until there's no taste left.

lines.zh: 栅栏外有脚步声，我不抬头。
lines.en: Footsteps beyond the fence. I don't look up.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在木栏上打盹。
lines.en: I rest my head on the rail and doze.

lines.zh: 阳光挪了，我也跟着挪。
lines.en: The sun moves, and I move with it.

lines.zh: 你袖口有干草，刚翻过草垛吧。
lines.en: Your sleeve has hay; you just turned a bale.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶，是来挤奶的吗？
lines.en: Is that bucket for my milk?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，嘴巴没停过嚼。
lines.en: I stare at you while my mouth keeps chewing.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上沾着别的牧场的泥。
lines.en: Your boots carry mud from another pasture.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我不躲也不迎。
lines.en: You step closer; I neither flee nor meet you.

lines.zh: 我眼睛大，看得清你袖口的草屑。
lines.en: My big eyes catch the grass on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你在看我背上的花纹吗？
lines.en: Are you counting the patches on my back?

lines.zh: 我歪过头，角尖冲着你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and my horn tips toward you.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味让我想起屠夫。
lines.en: The iron smell on you reminds me of the butcher.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，继续嚼我的草。
lines.en: I glance at you once, then keep chewing my grass.

lines.zh: 你站得比栅栏还直。
lines.en: You stand straighter than the fence posts.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，表示我看过你了。
lines.en: I blink slowly, which means I have seen you.

lines.zh: 牛皮一痛，我往前冲了两步。
lines.en: Pain in my hide sends me forward two steps.

lines.zh: 刀口很浅，只是血珠冒出来。
lines.en: The cut is shallow; only a bead of blood.

lines.zh: 这一刀下去，我会躲得更远。
lines.en: After that cut, I will keep my distance.

lines.zh: 我十点生命，掉得很快。
lines.en: I have ten points of life, and it falls fast.

lines.zh: 我叫出声，声音在平原上散开。
lines.en: I bellow once and the sound spreads over the plains.

lines.zh: 皮会被剥走，我知道。
lines.en: I know my hide will be taken.

lines.zh: 我退到栅栏边，后腿发软。
lines.en: I back to the fence, hind legs going weak.

lines.zh: 你砍的是我，不是草。
lines.en: You struck me, not the grass.

lines.zh: 血滴在花纹上，看不出来。
lines.en: Blood on my patches is hard to see.

lines.zh: 我还能走，就还没倒。
lines.en: I can still walk, so I have not fallen.

lines.zh: 小麦在手，我立刻忘了草。
lines.en: Show wheat and I forget the grass entirely.

lines.zh: 你晃那束麦子，我就跟着走。
lines.en: Wave that wheat and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 我闻到麦香，鼻子先动了。
lines.en: I smell the wheat and my nose moves first.

lines.zh: 别逗太久，我会用角顶你。
lines.en: Do not tease too long, or I will use my horns.

lines.zh: 桶里有盐？那我更靠近一点。
lines.en: Is there salt in the bucket? Then I step closer.

lines.zh: 我伸舌头，够不到你的手。
lines.en: I stretch my tongue but cannot reach your hand.

lines.zh: 你手里的麦子往哪走，我就往哪走。
lines.en: Wherever the wheat goes, I go.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我才懒得理你。
lines.en: Once I am full, I stop caring about you.

lines.zh: 那麦穗别晃太高，我脖子短。
lines.en: Do not hold the wheat too high; my neck is short.

lines.zh: 我跟着这束麦子，跟你没关系。
lines.en: I follow the wheat bundle, not you.

lines.zh: 我身子一沉，你被顶开半步。
lines.en: My bulk shifts and knocks you back half a step.

lines.zh: 别推我，我这十点生命不经撞。
lines.en: Do not shove me; ten points of life bruises easily.

lines.zh: 牛角擦过你的胳膊，凉。
lines.en: My horn grazes your arm, cold and quick.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的蹄印，滑了一下。
lines.en: You step in my hoofprint and slip.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，花纹贴着你过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and my patches brush past you.

lines.zh: 撞上我像撞一袋湿草。
lines.en: Bumping me feels like hitting a sack of wet grass.

lines.zh: 你退开，我甩了甩尾巴。
lines.en: You pull away and I flick my tail.

lines.zh: 我的角没尖，但你该让路。
lines.en: My horns are blunt, but you should still yield.

lines.zh: 我们卡在栅栏口，谁也不动。
lines.en: We jam in the gate mouth and neither moves.

lines.zh: 你从我肚子底下钻过去，胆子不小。
lines.en: You slip beneath my belly; that takes nerve.

lines.zh: 两头牛挨着站，尾巴缠在一起。
lines.en: Two cows stand close, tails tangled together.

lines.zh: 我蹭她的脖子，花纹挤成一团。
lines.en: I nuzzle her neck and our patches blur.

lines.zh: 平原上的牛群又要多一张嘴。
lines.en: The plains herd will have one more mouth to feed.

lines.zh: 我们低声叫，像在商量什么。
lines.en: We low softly, as if agreeing on something.

lines.zh: 她走开，我又慢慢跟上去。
lines.en: She walks off and I follow slowly.

lines.zh: 两头牛并排，谁也没先低头。
lines.en: Two cows side by side, neither lowering its head.

lines.zh: 我把额头贴在她角根上。
lines.en: I press my forehead to the base of her horns.

lines.zh: 小牛出生前，我们守在草窝边。
lines.en: Before the calf comes, we guard the grass nest.

lines.zh: 她甩尾，我也甩尾，算是回答。
lines.en: She flicks her tail; I flick mine back.

lines.zh: 牛群里只有我们两个落后。
lines.en: In the whole herd, only we two fall behind.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷起草，一点没掉。
lines.en: My tongue curls the grass up without dropping any.

lines.zh: 那件皮甲我不捡，太沉。
lines.en: I will not pick up that leather armor; too heavy.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖把桶推到栅栏边。
lines.en: I nudge the bucket to the fence with my nose.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的麦子，我用嘴收。
lines.en: Wheat on the ground, I gather it with my mouth.

lines.zh: 牛蹄不会拿东西，只会踩。
lines.en: Hooves cannot hold things, only press them down.

lines.zh: 我把落下的苹果顶到你脚边。
lines.en: I roll the fallen apple to your feet.

lines.zh: 有东西滚过来，我低头闻。
lines.en: Something rolls over and I lower my head to sniff.

lines.zh: 我咬住绳头，往回拖了一步。
lines.en: I bite the rope end and drag it one step.

lines.zh: 那把铁锹太窄，我含不住。
lines.en: That shovel is too thin for me to hold.

lines.zh: 我把草堆顶高，留给自己。
lines.en: I push the hay pile higher and keep it.

lines.zh: 谁拿刀靠近，我才抬头。
lines.en: Only when someone brings a blade do I look up.

lines.zh: 你举斧的样子，我认得。
lines.en: I know that raised axe stance of yours.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口白气，蹄子压紧。
lines.en: I huff white breath and plant my hooves.

lines.zh: 我的角慢慢朝下压。
lines.en: My horns lower slowly into a charging angle.

lines.zh: 十点生命，也够我试一次。
lines.en: Ten points of life is still worth one attempt.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，我退到草里。
lines.en: You come too close, so I back into the grass.

lines.zh: 屠夫身上那股铁味我记住了。
lines.en: I remember that iron smell the butcher carries.

lines.zh: 我不追人，除非被逼到栏角。
lines.en: I do not chase, unless cornered against the fence.

lines.zh: 蹄子刮了两下地，先试力。
lines.en: I scrape the dirt twice to test my footing.

lines.zh: 谁先动，我就朝谁冲。
lines.en: Whoever moves first gets my charge.

lines.zh: 我和你绕着草垛转。
lines.en: You and I circle the hay bale.

lines.zh: 地上的草够吃，我也不介意。
lines.en: There's grass enough — but you'll do.

lines.zh: 你绕左，我就转右。
lines.en: You go left; I turn right.

lines.zh: 我喘得响，声音在胸口震。
lines.en: I breathe loud, the sound shaking in my chest.

lines.zh: 草被我踩平，露出一条道。
lines.en: I trample the grass flat, opening a narrow path.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就停半步。
lines.en: You raise a shield and I pause half a step.

lines.zh: 我盯着你握刀的那只手。
lines.en: I fix on the hand holding your blade.

lines.zh: 牛眼里，你左右颠倒。
lines.en: In my cow eyes, your left and right are switched.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过去，不给空隙。
lines.en: I press forward step by step, leaving no gap.

lines.zh: 你要走，我就先挡栅栏口。
lines.en: If you leave, I block the gate first.

lines.zh: 角一顶，你整个人往后仰。
lines.en: My horns butt and you fall backward.

lines.zh: 我扬起前蹄，砸你肩膀。
lines.en: I rear up and bring my forelegs onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一撞不狠，但够你后退。
lines.en: This shove is not fierce, but it does move you.

lines.zh: 角根撞在肋骨上，闷响。
lines.en: The base of my horn hits your ribs with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你拨到草里。
lines.en: I swing my head and sweep you into the grass.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩下来，别伸手接。
lines.en: My hoof comes down; do not reach for it.

lines.zh: 我撞完就退，不追第二下。
lines.en: I hit once and retreat, no second blow.

lines.zh: 你裤子上的泥，是我留的印。
lines.en: The mud on your trousers is my mark.

lines.zh: 牛叫一声，比角更吓人。
lines.en: My low is scarier than my horns.

lines.zh: 我只会顶，不会咬。
lines.en: I only butt; I never bite.

lines.zh: 我出生在平原的草坡上，睁眼就是绿。
lines.en: I am born on a plains slope, green at first sight.

lines.zh: 花纹还没干，我就站起来了。
lines.en: My patches still wet, I already stand up.

lines.zh: 母牛舔我，把我推到草里。
lines.en: The mother cow licks me and pushes me to grass.

lines.zh: 十点生命，从第一声牛叫开始。
lines.en: Ten points of life, starting with my first low.

lines.zh: 我在栅栏外落地，四蹄先着地。
lines.en: I land outside the fence, hooves first.

lines.zh: 平原很宽，够我慢慢长大。
lines.en: The plains are wide enough for me to grow slowly.

lines.zh: 天亮时我出现在河湾的草地上。
lines.en: At dawn I appear on the meadow by the river bend.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，远处的牛回了。
lines.en: I call once; a cow far away answers.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味吹到狼那边去了。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent toward the wolves.

lines.zh: 一落地，我就找最近的草。
lines.en: The moment I land, I look for the nearest grass.

lines.zh: 牛群把我围在中间，像围一袋粮。
lines.en: The herd closes around me like a sack of grain.

lines.zh: 我踩着露水，走进这片平原。
lines.en: I walk into these plains, hooves wet with dew.

lines.zh: 火苗一舔，我的皮就缩紧了。
lines.en: One lick of flame and my hide shrinks tight.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，角磕进土里。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and my horn digs into dirt.

lines.zh: 水里我抬着头，鼻子快没影了。
lines.en: In the water I lift my head, nose barely above it.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，花纹全是土。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and my patches are all dirt.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，我甩不掉它。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back and I cannot shake it.

lines.zh: 药水一泼，我腿一软跪下去。
lines.en: A potion splashes and my legs buckle under me.

lines.zh: 草就在旁边，我却没力气低头。
lines.en: Grass is right there, but I cannot lower my head.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，眼前一片白。
lines.en: Lightning hits my horn and everything goes white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: No grass in the void; I keep falling.
